Whether xi can be excluded from sink candidacy given the ancestor sets known so far

Source: R/lingam_rcd.r
exists_ancestor_in_U.Rd

Faithful port of the exclusion rule in rcd.py (original 165-174 lines): xi cannot be the sink of U if (a) xi is already known to be an ancestor of some other member of U, or (b) every other member of U is already known to be an ancestor of xi.

Usage

exists_ancestor_in_U(M, U, xi, xj_list)

Arguments

M

current ancestor-set list

U

variable-set under consideration (unused except via xj_list, kept for signature parity with the upstream port)

xi

candidate variable

xj_list

U minus xi

Value

TRUE if xi should be excluded from sink candidacy
